entertainment.summary: Styles, who won album of the year with 'Harry's House' back in 2023, was completely shut out of the Grammy race this time, one of the most notable snubs this season.
entertainment.body:
It was less than four years ago that Harry Styles won the Grammy for album of the year, but he won’t get a chance to defend his title or win another Grammy this go around for his latest album Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally , as he was completely shut out of the 2027 Grammy nominations .

Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally was a bit more sonically complex than Styles’ past album of the year winner Harry’s House , and heading into this year, Styles was widely looked at as a Grammy contender for his latest release, which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 album chart while lead single “Aperture” hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Neither the album nor the single had the same staying power as Harry’s House or its lead single “As It Was,” though he gave the album more buzz with a 30-show Madison Square Garden residency as part of his Together, Together tour. Evidently, it wasn’t enough to sway the Grammy voters. Related Stories Movies Lady Gaga and Doechii's "Runway" Is Sole 'Devil Wears Prada 2' Song Oscar Submission (Exclusive) Music John Summit Blasts Grammys After Dance Snub: "It's All a F***ing Joke"

Other surprise shutouts this morning include Gracie Abrams , who wasn’t nominated for her third album Daughter From Hell , which hit No. 1 on the Billboard 200, and Hilary Duff, whose comeback record Luck … Or Something , for new label Atlantic Records , was released in February and debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200. While Abrams scored a best new artist nomination in 2024, it’s not her first time getting the Grammys ‘ cold shoulder, also failing to land expected song and record of the year nods last year for “That’s So True.”

Others were lucky enough to score nominations but maybe not as many as pundits (or fans) had expected. Noah Kahan landed just one nomination, for best contemporary folk album, for his The Great Divide , despite a number of experts predicting the former best new artist nominee would score top nods for his latest effort.

And while Madonna ‘s Confessions II was an eagerly awaited follow-up to 2005’s Confessions from the pop superstar and landed her four nominations , the release failed to net the seven-time Grammy winner any nominations in the major categories, including album, record and song of the year.

For anyone else, five Grammy nominations is an incredibly impressive feat, but even though that’s how many nods superstar singer-songwriter Taylor Swift received Monday — with noms in all three of the general categories — it’s perhaps an understated showing compared to what we’ve come to expect for the world’s biggest artist.

entertainment.title: Louis Carr Exits as BET President
entertainment.summary: Carr was named president in December 2025.
entertainment.body:
Louis Carr has exited BET less than one year after he was named president. Carr was with the brand for 40 years.

Cheeks says Skydance “believe(s) deeply” in BET and “are committed” to its future.

Carr’s tenure will officially end when 2026 officially ends. It was Carr’s decision to exit, Cheeks says. Skydance acquired BET with its Paramount merger, which closed last summer. Carr was named BET president in December 2025.

“We will have more to share soon on BET leadership and structure,” Cheeks wrote on Monday.

Carr’s farewell email, like his tenure, was lengthy. Read his message in full below.

Dear Team, For 40 years, I have had one of the best jobs in the media and entertainment industry. Having a position that gives one the opportunity to carry out a purpose that is bigger than oneself is a privilege. Working for a brand whose mission from day one was to uplift and empower the Black community is an honor I’ll never forget.

That said, even as I write this email, I wrestle with my decision that the time has come to make a transition. Based on recent events within our community and our country, I’ve decided to chart a new path and my last day will be December 31.

I am particularly proud of the momentum we have created and the work we have undertaken to strengthen the brand, expand our business and reaffirm BET’s place at the center of Black culture. Stepping into the role of President gave me the opportunity to see just how much the BET brand is loved by our talent, our consumers and the next generation.

entertainment.title: Columbia Leads, Indies Shine, Island Extends BNA Streak: Big 4 Grammy Categories by Record Label
entertainment.summary: Ella Langley and Rosalía helped Columbia lead all labels in Big Four Grammy nominations, while the indies had their best showing in years.
entertainment.body:
Columbia Records emerged Monday (Nov. 16) with nine nominations among the traditional Big Four Grammy categories of album, record and song of the year and best new artist for the 2027 ceremony, easily leading all record labels among those areas of the general field. That’s the most nominations in the Big Four since Interscope had 13 for the 2024 ceremony.

Ella Langley led the way for Columbia, with nominations in each of the Big Four — making her the fifth artist since the expansion of the categories to land nominations in each of the major general field areas, joining Sabrina Carpenter (2025), Chappell Roan (2025), Olivia Rodrigo (2022) and Billie Eilish (2020). (Eilish famously swept them all, only the second time that has ever happened, after Christopher Cross in 1981.) Langley’s “Choosin Texas” shattered the record for most weeks at No. 1 on the Hot 100 this year, at 28 weeks and counting, while her album Dandelion reached No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in April. Joining Langley among Columbia’s nominees is Rosalía , whose LUX album and single “Berghain” were nominated for album, record and song (she got a BNA nom herself in 2020), while Tame Impala and JENNIE ’s “Dracula” (record) and Slayyyter , signed to RECORDS/Columbia (BNA) rounded out the label’s Big Four nominees.

Behind Columbia is a trio of labels, including Republic, represented in album ( Taylor Swift , The Life of a Showgirl ), record (Swift, “The Fate of Ophelia”) and song of the year (Swift, “I Knew It, I Knew You” and Ariana Grande , “Hate That I Made You Love Me”); Atlantic, with a trio of Bruno Mars noms (album, The Romantic ; record, “I Just Might”; and song, “Risk It All”) as well as a best new artist nod for Don Toliver ; and Island, which saw a trio of nods for last year’s best new artist winner Olivia Dean (album, The Art of Loving ; and record and song for “Man I Need”) as well as another best new artist nominee in Remi Wolf . Notably, that’s the third straight year with a BNA for Island Records, and its fifth in three years, extending the longest-running active streak for a label and highlighting its recent dominance, particularly among young and rising female pop artists — Carpenter, Roan, Dean and Wolf join Lola Young on that list since the 2025 awards. The last label with that many BNA nods in that period was Columbia, which had five in three years between 2020 and 2022, and actually had six across four years when including 2019. Prior to 2019, that feat got a lot more difficult, given that the category was limited to five entries per year through 2018.

entertainment.title: RAYE Tearfully Reacts to Scoring 11 2027 Grammy Nods, More Than Any Other Artist: ‘WHAT IS HAPPENING’

RAYE ‘s music may contain hope, and it definitely contains Grammy potential. The list of 2027 nominations dropped on Monday (Nov. 16), with the British singer-songwriter scoring more nods than anyone else with 11 total — news that brought her to tears.

The star’s sophomore album, This Music May Contain Hope , reached No. 11 on the Billboard 200 and the top of the U.K.’s Official Albums Chart in April, marking her first No. 1 album in her home country. It has soundtracked a massive year for RAYE, who in 2026 graced the cover of Billboard ‘s Indie Power Players issue, won the prestigious Mercury Prize and booked her acting debut in upcoming thriller Lineage.

Some of RAYE’s peers chimed in to congratulate her in the comments of her post, with fellow song, album and record of the year nominee Olivia Dean writing, “yes queen!!!!!!!”

“YEASSS” commented Sienna Spiro, who’s up for best new artist at the 2027 Grammys .

entertainment.title: Don Toliver & Cardi B Dominate Nominations: Rap Grammy Reactions
entertainment.summary: We also take a look at why there weren't any Drake nominations, and give Wale and three rap legends their flowers.
entertainment.body:
The 2027 Grammy nominations are here and there are some interesting subplots in the Rap category, so I’m here to break some of them down for you.

The main story is that rap was shut out of album of the year, song of the year and record of the year. Now, depending on you ask, that could be a bad, the sky is falling sort of omen, or it could be that some may feel like the Grammys are a bit out of touch when it comes to rap music. I think, in this case, two things can be true. There’s also the fact that Drake didn’t submit anything from his triple-release of Iceman , Maid of Honour and Habibti for consideration, as the Toronto rapper seems to be unimpressed with the Grammys as an institution, clique and a label these days.

Something that the Grammys did get right, though, is rewarding Don Toliver for his 2026. His Octane album has been a mainstay on the charts and is arguably the consensus rap album of year — a status it’s basically held since it dropped in January. We gotta also acknowledge Cardi B, who after making fans wait seven years for her to follow up her debut Invasion of Privacy , has four nominations to her name this year. She and Don have been rap’s dominant mainstream acts this year, alongside Yung Miami with her breakout hit “Spend Dat” — which, for my money, is the rap song of year.

Then we have a respected rap veteran in Wale, and some legends with Busta Rhymes, T.I. and De La Soul.

Folarin’s album everything is a lot. is up for best rap album — his first nomination in 15 years. Busta has two nominations in best rap album for the J Dilla-produced Dillagence II and best melodic rap performance for “This Woman” featuring D’Angelo. T.I. also has two nominations thanks to his hit record “Let Em Know” which is up for best rap performance and best rap song, respectively, and De La Soul’s “Run It Back” featuring Nas is also up for best rap performance.

For the first time since 2013, rap has been shut out of three major categories. There will not be any rap music nominated for album of the year, song of the year, or record of the year this year, which is a bit hard to believe given the genre’s influence on other genres like pop (see: ADELÁ’s “Nicole Kidman” ) and Country (see: Morgan Wallen & Jelly Roll.) I guess nobody at the Academy was outside when Yung Miami’s “Spend Dat” came on at the club or at the New York Knicks championship parade.

Much has been said about rap’s waining chart dominance the last couple of years, so this could be a sign of things to come… or not. Since streaming has become the go-to place to listen to music, the music industry has been forced to constantly adapt. It looks like the mainstream rap industry needs to look in the mirror and reinvent itself once again.

entertainment.title: Inside the Wild Nights of Martin Scorsese and Robbie Robertson’s 1970s L.A. Adventure
entertainment.summary: After ‘The Last Waltz,’ the director and the leader of the Band moved in together — and that’s when things got crazy
entertainment.body:
Jonathan Taplin reached out during the summer of 1976, 10 days into the shooting of New York, New York . He’d reconnected with the Band . The guys were planning an all-star farewell concert on Thanksgiving at the Winterland Ballroom, the promoter Bill Graham’s San Francisco venue. Marty had obviously moved well beyond the concert-documentary phase of his career, but might he consider filming the proceedings?

Not long after, Taplin recalled, he and Robbie Robertson visited Marty at his office on the MGM lot. “He was living a very crazy existence,” Taplin said. “First off, he was having an affair with Liza Minnelli. And yet his wife, Julia Cameron, was around on the set all the time. So he was constantly ducking out. He had a dressing room on the MGM lot that had a daybed in it. It was very, very weird. It was insane. And they were all doing so much coke.” Steve Prince (“a kind of hangout guy, driver, bodyguard, and coke dealer”) had firmly become “part of the entourage” by that point, Taplin added. “He was the guy who would stand outside of Marty’s trailer on the set of New York, New York and bar the door.”

Later, Robbie met with Marty over dinner at the Mandarin, an upscale Chinese restaurant in Beverly Hills, at the time a novelty. In an auspice of their future partnership-in-crime, each man brought along his wife and girlfriend, in Marty’s case, Julia and Liza, in Robbie’s, his wife, Dominique Bourgeois, a Québécois journalist, and her friend Geneviève Bujold, the actress. Marty, the music fanatic, held Robbie somewhat in awe: They were the same age, but Robbie had joined the Band at 16 and had been woodshedding with Dylan when Marty was still an anonymous film student struggling to complete his second short. Robbie took note of Marty’s intense gaze that night, given a slightly devilish cast by his dark Vandyke beard. Later he would say, of possible directors, that Marty “was the only person that knew enough about the fucking music and grew up on it just like me, and was basically just as much a punk as the rest of us. He could relate to the whole fucking thing.” Editor’s picks The 250 Greatest Albums of the 21st Century So Far The 100 Best TV Episodes of All Time The 500 Greatest Albums of All Time 100 Best Movies of the 21st Century

After dinner, they hit On the Rox, an after-hours bar on Sunset Boulevard, upstairs from the Roxy nightclub, which had become a clubhouse and discreet drug spot for hard-partying celebrities like John Lennon, Jack Nicholson, and Harry Nilsson. They started talking about documenting the concert “on a small level, maybe just video or 16mm,” Robbie said. Marty knew United Artists and the producers of New York, New York would never allow him to moonlight on another film, even a documentary, simultaneously. Then again, hadn’t John Huston managed to sneak off for big-game safaris during the filming of The African Queen ? Couldn’t Marty slip away with a film crew over Thanksgiving weekend, when the New York, New York production would be on holiday anyway, not to shoot an elephant but a simple rock concert? As Robbie revealed the guests he’d invited to perform — Dylan, Muddy Waters, Van Morrison, Joni Mitchell, Neil Young — Marty stopped pretending to fight. What the hell would the studio do, fire him?

Use a hyperrealistic videogame, whose players donned a shiny metal helmet, to trick players into solving a seemingly unsolvable mathematical/astronomical problem. Season 1 followed a modern-day group of students at Oxford University and someone who'd experienced China's Cultural Revolution firsthand as they were drawn into the intrigue.

Season 1 began streaming in March 2024 . The series, which hails from David Benioff and D.B. Weiss ("Game of Thrones") and Alexander Woo ("True Blood"), was renewed for Season 2 in May of that year.

The 54-year-old continued that while "recovery hasn't been painful" from the procedure, she's been struggling with grief after the recent deaths of her best friend Mark H. Hasche and her dad Guy Glanville .

“I feel like I’m so sad about my dad and Mark," she shared, "that I don’t notice physical pain."

And her health has only complicated her grief journey. Glanville added that she feels "some guilt" after missing Hasche's funeral because she has "so much fluid" in her head.

"I keep on thinking and talking myself into this crazy thing like, ‘Oh my God, people hate me. Mark’s family hates me,’” she said. "It just wasn’t possible. I couldn’t fly. I couldn’t drive."

However, the Special Forces star—who has long suspected a parasite is to blame for her health problems—believes a breakthrough could be imminent. Detailing how she’s now "on antibiotics almost 24 hours a day" Glanville is "excited" after "seeing a difference" with a new medication she's been taking.

entertainment.title: Howie Mandel to Host ‘Joker’s Wild’ Game Show Revival
entertainment.summary: Sony is producing the show, which is set to go into syndication on CBS-owned stations in the fall of 2027.
entertainment.body:
Logo text Sony Pictures Television is putting a new spin on the classic game show The Joker’s Wild .

The studio is set to start filming on a new version of the show, with Howie Mandel as host. The Joker’s Wild will debut in syndication on CBS-owned stations in fall 2027.

Sony doing business with CBS is notable, as the two companies had a protracted legal fight over two other game shows: Jeopardy! and Wheel of Fortune . The two sides settled a lawsuit a year ago that involved disputes over distribution contracts for the Sony-produced shows. CBS Media Ventures will handle ad sales for the new series. Related Stories TV Shemar Moore's Hondo Trains LAPD Misfits for Redemption in 'S.W.A.T. Exiles' Trailer TV 'Wheel of Fortune' Announcer Suspended Amid Investigation

As for The Joker’s Wild , the new game will keep the oversized slot machines and gameplay of the original show (which was a daytime staple in the 1970s and ’80s) and add a new bonus round.

“I love that we’re bringing The Joker’s Wild back,” said Mandel. “It’s such a fun, crazy show, and getting to be a part of that is a real honor. There’s something great about taking a show people have loved for years and seeing what you can do with it today. I’m excited to get in there, have some laughs, and probably make a little bit of a mess along the way. That’s usually when I’m having the most fun.”

Jack Barry created and hosted the original version of the show. It had a brief revival in the early 1990s, and Snoop Dogg hosted a new version of The Joker’s Wild on TBS and TNT from 2017-19.

“ The Joker’s Wild is one of the most recognizable brands in game show history, with a format that combines trivia, unpredictability and big-money stakes,” said Suzanne Prete, president of game shows at Sony Pictures Television. “Howie brings exactly the kind of wit, energy and spontaneity that this game demands. With him at the helm, we’re excited to introduce The Joker’s Wild to a new generation of viewers and continue evolving this iconic franchise for today’s audiences without losing the qualities that made it a favorite in the first place.”

Mashawn Nix ( Deal or No Deal, Match Game ) is the executive producer and showrunner of The Joker’s Wild. Filming is set to begin this month at Sony’s Culver City lot.

sports.title: Panthers sign CB Marco Wilson to the active roster
sports.summary: Cornerback Marco Wilson had a hand in one of the Panthers' two takeaways in Sunday's win over the Saints and he moved up to a spot on the active roster on Monday.
sports.body:
Wilson was elevated from the practice squad three times this season and the Panthers announced that he has been signed to the active roster on Monday. Linebacker Nick Hampton was waived in a corresponding move.

Wilson broke up a pass to wide receiver Chris Olave in the first quarter on Sunday and the ball caromed to linebacker Devin Lloyd for an interception. He also had three tackles during the 20-17 victory.

Wilson has 15 tackles and four passes defensed over all three of his appearances.

sports.title: Stephen Jones: We're playing "unacceptable" football, our fans deserve better
sports.summary: Sunday's loss to the 49ers dropped the Cowboys to 4-6 on the season and magnified the season-long struggles that the team has had on the defensive side of the ball.
sports.body:
The 49ers scored three touchdowns that covered at least 66 yards on their way to compiling 584 yards in the 46-40 win. Those difficulties have led to calls for the team to move on from head coach Brian Schottenheimer and defensive coordinator Christian Parker.

The Cowboys have not indicated that any changes are on the horizon, but executive vice president Stephen Jones said on 105.3 The Fan on Monday that the team is “not doing what it takes to win these football games” right now. Jones outlined the places where the team is falling short and those areas were frequently on the defensive side of the ball, which led to question late in his appearance about his response to the calls for major changes to the coaching staff.

“I just think at the end of the day, I certainly understand their frustration because there’s no doubt that we’re frustrated,” Jones said. “We feel like the way we’re playing ball right now is unacceptable. Our fans certainly deserve better.”

Games against the Titans and Eagles in the next two weeks give the Cowboys a chance to get back to .500 heading into the final chunk of the regular season. That won’t erase the missed opportunities over the first 10 weeks, but it will give the current regime one more chance to show that they can correct the issues before the Cowboys decide if it is time to give others a chance to right the ship.

sports.title: Quenton Nelson is not healthy enough to practice yet, Seahawks are unsure when he will be
sports.summary: When the Seahawks traded for Quenton Nelson, they added one of the best guards in the NFL — when he's healthy.
sports.body:
After playing in Week 8 against the Bears, Nelson missed Week 9 and Week 10 with a knee injury. The Seahawks are on their bye in Week 11, but head coach Mike Macdonald said today that if they were practicing, Nelson would not be able to participate.

Asked when Nelson will practice, Macdonald said it’s too early to put a date on that.

“I know he really wants to play, but right now I think we’re too far out to put a practice conjecture on Q,” Macdonald said.

By trading for Nelson, the Seahawks were making an aggressive move to add a piece they hope can help them win another Super Bowl this year. The hope is that he’ll be ready to play down the stretch, but it’s unclear just how soon he’ll be back on the field.

He’s shown progress, but we’ll see where he is by the end of the week.”

The Packers opened Parsons’ 21-day practice window earlier this month, setting him up for his return. He has been a limited participant in practice for all three days in each of the last two weeks.

sports.title: Sean Payton: "There's no loophole" in the trade process
sports.summary: Payton disputes JIm Harbaugh's characterization of the failed Daiyan Henley trade.
sports.body:
The Broncos had no comment last week, and coach Sean Payton hadn’t spoken to reporters because Denver had a Week 10 bye.

On Monday, Payton was available to the media. And the first question asked what changed as to the Henley trade.

“Nothing changed,” Payton said. “It was already stated. Everything was pretty clearly spelled out. I’m not going to get into the specifics. He’s a prospect we thought — and still do [think] — very highly of. It just didn’t work out and it’s not uncommon with trades. That’s kind of where it went, and I’ll leave it at that.”

“There’s no loophole,” Payton said. “It just is part of the trade process every step of the way.”

He’s technically right, but there is a loophole. A team that has buyer’s remorse can try to rely on issues with the physical to negotiate better terms. And an unscrupulous team could finalize a deal before the deadline with the plan of trying to improve the deal later, under the guise of a failed physical.

The easy fix, when it comes to deadline deals, is to take the position that, after the window for making trades closes, the player either passes the physical and the trade goes through as negotiated or the player fails the physical and the deal dies.

There should be no “maybe” box when it comes to physicals. Especially after the period for making trades has ended.

sports.title: UFL's BattleHawks work out a deal to stay at dome in St. Louis
sports.summary: As of last month, the UFL had a stadium issue in St.
sports.body:
Via Fox 2 in St. Louis, the UFL and the powers-that-be have struck a deal to create better flexibility in the scheduling of five BattleHawks home games at The Dome at America’s Center.

Under the prior schedule, the BattleHawks would have played four straight home games, followed by five straight road games, capped by a home game. The details of the revised schedule have not yet been announced.

UFL co-owner Mike Repole, who has been aggressively using Twitter to market the league and to squabble directly with critics, took a social-media victory lap.

“ We weren’t going to settle ,” he posted. “We pushed for better. We got it done!!!! A BIG THANK YOU to our partners at The Dome at America’s Center.”

While the UFL is largely a made-for-TV league, it has been trying to create better visuals by playing in stadiums that are easier to fill. The size of the dome in St. Louis makes that harder. Stacking four home games together in four straight weekends won’t make that any easier.

Seattle will have its bye in Week 11. But head coach Mike Macdonald said in an interview with Seattle Sports 710 on Monday that Darnold could be back for the Week 12 matchup against the 49ers.

“I’d say we’re really optimistic that he’s going to be able to get a full week’s worth of work and be able to play against San Francisco ,” Macdonald said, via John Boyle of the team’s website.

Macdonald also noted that backup Drew Lock won’t be replacing Darnold, saying, “Sam’s our starting quarterback.”

Darnold has missed the last two games with quad and rib injuries.

While Darnold’s performance has dipped in 2026, Macdonald has been steadfast in his support of the quarterback the club won the Super Bowl with in February.

Seattle is 3-4 in Darnold’s starts this season — with Drew Lock playing most of the Week 1 win over New England. Darnold has completed 60.2 percent of his passes for 1,478 yards with 10 touchdowns and nine interceptions this season.

Lock, however, sports a 3-0 record this season. He’s completed 73.1 percent of his throws for 837 yards with seven touchdowns and no picks.

sports.title: Packers, Rams embark on shortest possible bye weeks
sports.summary: In Week 11, six teams will have a bye.
sports.body:
It’s the latest byproduct of the effort to find more places in the pizza into which cheese can be crammed (and/or from which cash can be siphoned).

The NFL will play its first-ever game on the night before Thanksgiving. The easiest, and more equitable, approach to scheduling entailed giving the Week 12 Wednesday assignment to teams that don’t play in Week 11.

Still, it’s not a real bye week. The Rams and Packers will play 10 days after their pre-bye games. The usual in-season break is 14 days.

It’s possible that a team could play on Monday night and the next Thursday, 10 days later. We’re not aware of that happening since the NFL embraced full-season Thursday night games; usually, the league tries to have the same amount of down time for both teams playing on a Thursday night.

Actually, the Packers will get more time off on the back end than the front end of their off week. Green Bay’s Week 13 game comes 11 days after the Week 12 game.

The Rams won’t be so lucky. They play the Chiefs on the following Thursday night, resulting in 10 days, 8 days, and 10 days between L.A. games.

But that’s how it will go in the new and improved NFL. More windows. More prime-time games. More international games.

sports.title: Mike Vrabel on Drake Maye: I wouldn't imagine him being available out of the bye
sports.summary: There has been mixed reporting about the status of Drake Maye's ankle injury after the Patriots lost to the Lions in Munich on Sunday.
sports.body:
New England will be on its bye in Week 11. In his Monday press conference, head coach Mike Vrabel would only go as far as noting the quarterback’s likely status for Week 12.

“I’m not going to make any comments about his status until he gets back here,” Vrabel said. “He’s en route back here. He stayed with a few of our people and they’re en route back here. So, once he gets back here, our people are able to visit with him again, talk with him again, I think we’ll have more to offer.

“But I wouldn’t imagine him being available when we come out of the bye.”

PFT reported on Sunday night that Maye is expected to be out for a while , with others reporting on Monday that the quarterback may not be back at all in 2026.

But Vrabel said at this point, he doesn’t expect the team to go and sign another quarterback. Tommy DeVito and and Behren Morton are the other QBs on the 53-man roster. The team does not have a quarterback on the practice squad.

I won’t fault you for questioning why I’m writing this now after Shakir had two catches for 29 yards — along with three “runs” for 26 yards — in the win over the Jets in Week 10. There are a few reasons — it’s a follow from one of my takeaways from Buffalo’s victory in MetLie Stadium, Amon-Ra St. Brown went off for the Lions against the Patriots in Germany, and Parker Washington had the most receiving yards in a game (152) for the Jaguars since 2019. Oh, and now is the ideal time to start incorporating Shakir into a more prominent role, right before the Bills have this five-game stretch during the holiday season — vs. Chiefs, at Patriots, at Packers, vs. Bears, and at Broncos. Let’s start general, with a question — who has been the Bills most reliable receiver for going on four seasons now? Shakir. Even in 2023, his second season as a professional, on a team with Stefon Diggs, Shakir’s yards-per-route run (1.79) rivaled Diggs’ (1.89). His drop rate was drastically lower than Diggs’ 2.0% vs. 6.4%, and he averaged 7.0 yards after contact per reception to Diggs’ 3.9. All those figures are counting the playoffs too. Yes, of course — sample size. Diggs was targeted 175 times to just 56 for Shakir that season. That’s drastic. Speaking of the playoffs… in the two Bills games that postseason, Shakir and Diggs both had 10 grabs. Shakir had slightly more yards 75 vs. 73 and scored two touchdowns to Diggs’ zero. Even if you believed Diggs was more reliable in 2023, from 2024 to the present day, we can all agree the answer to my original question is Shakir, right? And in Allen’s MVP campaign of 2024, Shakir led the team in targets (100), receptions (76), and yards (821) during the regular season. Correlation doesn’t automatically equal causation, but Shakir’s presence as Buffalo’s defacto No. 1 receiver during a season with outrageous efficiency from Buffalo’s offense shouldn’t be ignored. If any receiver has put in the time, paid his dues, and produced to a level that should earn more looks — it’s Shakir! sports.title: Vikings won't be leaving Minnesota for altitude acclimation
sports.summary: With quarterback Kirk Cousins back and the Minnesota defense playing at a championship level, the sky is the limit for the Vikings.
sports.body:
On Sunday, the extent to which they’ll be literally in the sky could limit the ability to get an eighth win.

The Week 11 prime-time showdown between the 7-2 Vikings and 8-1 49ers will happen in Mexico City, where the altitude is 7,280 feet above sea level. The Vikings won’t be relocating this week to acclimate to the thinner air.

The 49ers, in contrast, have gone from Dallas to Colorado , where they’ll train in the far lower distance of 5,280 feet above sea level.

The Vikings will have a plan to get their players ready to perform on an elevated field. Details will emerge this week.

Whatever the plan is, it won’t entail the same kind of direct acclimation in which the 49ers are engaging.

It sets up another apples-to-apples comparison regarding the plans for international games. In Week 1, the 49ers went to Australia early. The Rams went late. And the 49ers dominated L.A., winning 27-7.

This time around, the stakes are extremely high. The winner takes over the de facto driver’s seat for the top seed in the NFC.

A loss means more to the Vikings than the 49ers, as it relates to their respective divisions. San Francisco has a solid cushion over the Seahawks and Rams in the NFC West. The Vikings are caught in a three-way tie for first place in the NFC North.

sports.title: Buccaneers add QB Cooper Rush to practice squad
sports.summary: Cooper Rush is headed to a different team in the NFC South.
sports.body:
With starter Baker Mayfield banged up, Rush is signing with the Buccaneers practice squad, according to agency Equity Sports.

Rush was with the Falcons earlier this season, starting a pair of games with poor results. Rush completed 22-of-39 passes for 229 yards with one touchdown, four interceptions, and a lost fumble.

If Mayfield is not able to start this week against the Lions, rookie backup Jalon Daniels would presumably take Mayfield’s place as QB1. Daniels went 1-2 in his three starts while Mayfield was dealing with a thumb injury, completing 61.2 percent of his passes for 501 yards with three touchdowns and five interceptions.

sports.title: Sean McVay: Aaron Donald never ceases to amaze me, he's one-of-one
sports.summary: For the first time in 1,050 days, Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald recorded a sack when he brought down rookie Carson Beck during the second quarter of Sunday's victory over the Cardinals.
sports.body:
It was the first of two takedowns he was involved in on the day, as he was also credited for a half-sack later in the afternoon.

After the contest, head coach Sean McVay told reporters Donald “never ceases to amaze me.”

“I’m never surprised,” McVay said in his press conference. “I think the term ‘one-of-one’ is thrown around way too loosely in this day and age, but it’s not with him. He’s one-of-one. He can do things, he’s done things and his impact — whether he has to say it or just show it, he’s a total ‘G.’ I love everything he’s about, and he is one-of-one.

“He’s had a tremendous impact on this team and it certainly is not exclusive to just getting a sack today. He’s made a tremendous impact. He’s a guy that everybody looks at and they say, ‘Watching the way that he moves — if you just mimic and emulate that, we’ll be in good shape.’”

Donald has tallied 15 total tackles with four tackles for loss, four QB hits, and now 1.5 sacks since returning from his retirement at the start of the season.

sports.title: Report: Cowboys RG Tyler Booker has a high-ankle sprain
sports.summary: The Cowboys may be without right guard Tyler Booker in the coming weeks.
sports.body:
Booker left Sunday’s 46-40 loss to the 49ers after playing 33 offensive snaps and Ian Rapoport of NFL Media reports that he is dealing with a high-ankle sprain.

High-ankle sprains often lead to multi-week absences and Booker missed three games with a similar injury last season. The Cowboys face the Titans, Eagles and Seahawks before a bye in Week 14.

T.J. Bass took over for the final 50 snaps of Sunday’s loss and will likely be at right guard until Booker is cleared to return to action.

sports.title: Aaron Glenn had DC Brian Duker calling Jets defensive plays on Sunday
sports.summary: The Jets's eighth loss of the 2026 season had things in common with the previous seven, but Sunday's outing against the Bills was different in one significant way.
sports.body:
Head coach Aaron Glenn confirmed at a Monday press conference that he had defensive coordinator Brian Duker calling the defensive plays for the first time this season.

“I gave Duker the lead when it comes to that. I’m still a huge part of what we call,” Glenn said.

Glenn said last week that he was “ looking at everything ” when it came to finding ways for the Jets to improve on their 2-7 start and reiterated on Monday that he is willing to do “anything that I can do as a head coach to help us win games.” The Jets gave up 389 yards in the 31-12 loss to the Bills, including 201 rushing yards that included a 74-yard James Cook touchdown run late in the fourth quarter.

Duker’s predecessor Steve Wilks was Glenn’s initial defensive playcaller in 2025, but he was fired in mid-December and Glenn announced he would take over that responsibility in the offseason. Glenn had called the plays as the Lions’ defensive coordinator and called that his “ superpower ” in February, but opposing offenses have proven to be his kryptonite far too often during the 2026 season.

sports.title: Patrick Mahomes on his injured elbow: Obviously, it felt good enough
sports.summary: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes suffered a right elbow injury during the Week 9 victory over the Jets.
sports.body:
While it looked bad initially, it certainly didn’t seem to affect him in yesterday’s 35-13 victory over the Falcons.

Despite missing Kenneth Walker and dealing with other injuries on offense, Mahomes threw five touchdowns in a single game for the first time since 2022. He ended the victory 22-of-35 for 348 yards with no interceptions.

“Obviously, it felt good enough,” Mahomes said in his postgame press conference. “I was a little nervous going into the game, just because it was a little sore. But we did a great job, [Chiefs assistant athletic trainer] Julie [Frymer], and the whole training staff did a great job all week of just trying to make sure that I was in a great spot to go out there and compete, and I was able to do that today.

“I’m sure we’ll have some ice on it going back home. But we’ll continue that same process this next week, and try to get it as healthy as possible, as quickly as possible.”

“I didn’t feel like during the week of practice, I was driving the ball the way I wanted to,” Mahomes said. “Just because of some of those deeper in-cut routes and the different balls down the field, you don’t know until you get out there, that adrenaline starts kicking a little bit.

Mahomes now has completed 66.8 percent of his passes for 2,385 yards with 19 touchdowns and four interceptions this season. His 106.7 passer rating is his highest since 2022, when he finished at 105.2 and won his second MVP award.

sports.title: Dolphins waive Zane Gonzalez after three missed kicks on Sunday
sports.summary: The Dolphins are looking for a new kicker.
sports.body:
They announced that they have waived Zane Gonzalez on Monday. The move comes a day after Gonzalez had a hand in the team’s 24-22 loss to the Colts.

Gonzalez missed two field goals and an extra point as Miami fell to 1-8 on the season. That loss came despite the Dolphins picking up more yards than the Colts while winning the turnover battle and committing three penalties while the Colts were flagged 13 times.

It was Gonzalez’s fourth game with the Dolphins this season. He was a practice squad elevation for the first three appearances and the team will have someone else handling those duties in Buffalo in Week 11.

sports.title: Panthers on pace to set new NFL records for most penalties and penalty yards this season
sports.summary: The Panthers beat the Saints on Sunday despite being assessed a whopping 17 penalties for 152 yards.
sports.body:
Through nine games, the Panthers lead the NFL with 87 penalties for 787 yards. That puts them on pace for 164 penalties for 1,487 yards in 17 games, both of which would be new NFL records. The current NFL records were set by the 2011 Oakland Raiders, who were assessed 163 penalties for 1,358 yards.

Panthers coach Dave Canales said after Sunday’s game that he can accept some penalties that are naturally going to happen over the course of a game, but he doesn’t accept mental mistakes like jumping offside.

“Some of the penalties that are judgment calls, they’re gonna call them how they see them,” Canales said. “The things that I’m gonna focus on are the ones we have to take control of, which are offside penalties, pre-snap, delay of games, those type of procedural penalties. We’ve got to eliminate those. The competitive calls are going to happen. There’s ways to talk about the technique, but it’s really the things that we can control that we have to focus on.”

Asked if he had a problem with the officials on Sunday, who assessed the Saints just three penalties while the Panthers got 17, Canales answered, “I’m not gonna get into that.”

“We talked about the penalties. We set a new franchise record with 17, and we have to fix that. That’s not gonna be sustainable in this league, when the margins are so tight. The guys understand that,” Canales said.

What Canales will do is address what his own team can do better, perhaps improving enough over the second half of the season to avoid breaking a record that no coach wants to break.

sports.title: ACC announces punishments after Louisville-North Carolina brawl
sports.summary: The ACC has spoken.
sports.body:
After Saturday night’s brawl at the end of the game between Louisville and North Carolina, the conference has issued a statement listing the “ suspensions, institutional fines, and public reprimands ” arising from the incident.

“The unsportsmanlike behavior displayed was unacceptable,” the conference said, “and each institution will incur a fine.”

The ACC also has suspended Louisville linebacker Stanquan Clark and North Carolina defensive back Greg Smith III for the first half of their programs’ next games.

Without knowing the fines, it’s impossible to know how significant the punishments were. The fact that only two players will miss only one half of a game seems to be on the light side of the range of consequences that could have been issued to the players.

The incident was sparked by North Carolina’s Schiano-style attack against Louisville’s effort to end the game in victory formation. It was a confusing degree of aggression/desperation, given that the Tar Heels had a timeout that they did not use.

It was quite possibly frustration from UNC after falling short in their effort to get a sixth win and, in turn, to become bowl-eligible.

sports.title: Geno Smith getting tests on ankle, will start in Week 11 if healthy
sports.summary: Jets quarterback Geno Smith was forced out of Sunday's loss to the Bills with an ankle injury and his status for Week 11 is still to be determined.
sports.body:
Head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters at a Monday press conference that Smith is having tests on his ankle on Monday. Smith missed one series earlier in the game to have a concussion evaluation and left the game for good after hurting his ankle in the third quarter.

Glenn confirmed that Smith will remain the team’s starter against the Chargers if he is cleared medically. Rookie Cade Klubnik made his regular season debut on Sunday and will make his first NFL start if Smith is unable to play.

Rookie wideout Omar Cooper also left Sunday’s game with an ankle injury and he’ll go for tests on Monday as well.

sports.title: Josh Allen ties Eric Dickerson, Curtis Martin at 90 rushing touchdowns
sports.summary: Josh Allen has as many rushing touchdowns as Eric Dickerson. Yes, we’re comparing a quarterback to the guy who ran for 2,105 yards in one season. Allen scored his 90th career rushing touchdown during Buffalo’s Week 10 game against the New York Jets, tying Dickerson and fellow Hall of Famer Curtis Ma
sports.body: Josh Allen has as many rushing touchdowns as Eric Dickerson. Yes, we’re comparing a quarterback to the guy who ran for 2,105 yards in one season. [Media: https://twitter.com/BuffaloBillsPR/status/2122058091134881834?a=hfBRzB3qb8hT6ZX9EDw&s=20] Allen scored his 90th career rushing touchdown during Buffalo’s Week 10 game against the New York Jets, tying Dickerson and fellow Hall of Famer Curtis Martin for 14th on the NFL’s all-time list. He entered the game with 88. Number 89 came on a one yard run in the first quarter. Number 90 was a two-yard run on the Bills’ first possession of the third quarter. [Media: https://twitter.com/BuffaloBills/status/2122034725476766076?a=C37X0KjNpeEIGge-adI&s=20] [Media: https://twitter.com/BuffaloBills/status/2122057732488376770?a=x6C71tZcVsvn-l8ycns&s=20] Dickerson and Martin weren’t running backs who had a few good seasons. Dickerson led the NFL in rushing four times, and nobody has topped his single-season yardage record in more than 40 years. Martin opened his career with 10 straight 1,000-yard seasons, including seven with the New York Jets. Bills fans had plenty of opportunities to get tired of watching him, but now they can celebrate one of their own making what he did look average. Both finished with 90 rushing touchdowns. Allen has matched them in his ninth season while also being responsible for, you know, throwing the football. The quarterback record is already his. It has been for a while. Now Allen has reached the point where we’re comparing his touchdown total to some of the best running backs to ever play, and he could pass a few more before this season is over. One more rushing touchdown would tie Jerome Bettis and Franco Harris for 12th at 91. Barry Sanders is next at 99, followed by Marshall Faulk and Shaun Alexander at 100. Allen would need 10 more to join that pair in ninth place, which is asking a lot. But we’re talking about a quarterback with a chance to finish the season in the NFL’s top 10 for career rushing touchdowns. We can keep asking him to slide, but we shouldn’t expect that he will. Apparently, he has a few more people to catch first.

sports.title: Report: Aidan Hutchinson is out for the season with torn ACL, likely additional damage
sports.summary: Hutchinson suffered the season-ending injury while celebrating a sack of Drake Maye, who was also injured.
sports.body:
Hutchinson has a torn ACL in his right knee and probably additional damage, according to Ian Rapoport.

The torn ACL was seen on the MRI he had in Germany after leaving Sunday’s game, and the team plans to give him additional tests now that he’s back in Detroit. There are concerns that he also injured his meniscus.

Hutchinson is one of the best defensive players in the NFL and his loss is devastating to the Lions, who are 7-2 and have legitimate Super Bowl hopes. They also had legitimate Super Bowl hopes two years ago, when Hutchinson suffered a season-ending broken leg, and their defense wasn’t the same without him.

The injury came moments after Hutchinson sacked Drake Maye. Hutchinson got up, jumped in the air celebrating, and landed awkwardly, with his right knee seeming to buckle. He immediately went to the ground and grabbed his leg.

Maye was also injured on the play, missed the rest of the game and is likely out for a significant period of time.

sports.title: Joe Burrow becomes the MVP favorite
sports.summary: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is having a potentially historic season.
sports.body:
After registering a fifth straight game with four or more total touchdowns — matching Peyton Manning (2004) as the only two players to ever do that — Burrow has surged to a +105 favorite to win the MVP trophy.

Along the way, the Bengals blasted the Steelers, 38-18. Burrow completed 35 of 44 passes for 409 yards and four touchdowns, as Cincinnati outgained Pittsburgh, 484 to 222.

Allen is second in the current odds, at +310. 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy lurks at +400, with Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence at +500.

There’s a gap after those four, with Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes at 16-1. (Seahawks receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who arguably best fits the official Associated Press definition of the term, remains an 80-1 long shot.)

The voting, which happens in the days after Week 18, will undoubtedly be influenced by the final configuration of the AFC and NFC playoff trees. Getting the top seed will give the quarterbacks of those teams a boost.

In the AFC, rhat could be the Bengals. Or the Bills. Or the Jaguars. Or the Chiefs. In the NFC, it could be the 49ers.

For now, Burrow has laid the foundation for a stretch run that earns his first career MVP award.

Michael Scott didn’t end up losing his job as branch manager of Dunder-Mifflin in the end. Nevertheless, the review remains relatable. Sometimes people can improve their job performance, but other times you reach a realization that they just aren’t capable of doing it. We are past that stage with Aaron Glenn. We can point to any number of dubious marks of his resume as Jets head coach. He is now 5-22, sporting a worse winning percentage as an NFL head coach than Hue Jackson. Glenn now has more than twice as many double digit point losses than he has wins. The latest defeat was the ugly 31-12 blowout at the hands of the Buffalo Bills in Week 10. There isn’t much drama left surrounding Glenn. Barring an unexpected late season surge, he will not retain his job as Jets head coach for a third year. Even if there is a late season winning streak, it still might not be enough. NFL teams don’t reassign their coach to a different department. Coaching contracts aren’t written that way, and practical considerations make the sort of demotion recommended for Scott unviable. Glenn will be let go. He will make enough money to leave football if he so chooses. If he decides to continue his coaching career, he will be an in demand candidates for teams seeking a new defensive coordinator. sports.body: The Buffalo Bills beat the Jets 31-12 in Week 10 on inside MetLife Stadium, in a game that went from defensive slugfest in the first two quarters to blowout in the second half. At 8-1, the Bills are out to their best start since 1991. These are my takeaways from Buffalo’s victory. I’m glad we saw some pass-game pop within structure During the Bills’ four-game win streak entering this game, which included dominance after the bye week, it felt natural to narrow focus on Buffalo’s entire operation, checking for any component of the team that could improve. And in wins over the Rams, Raiders, Ravens, and Vikings, Buffalo seemingly lacked efficiency from the pass game in a classic sense. You know, Josh Allen standing in the pocket and completing the football to pass catchers within the intended design of the play. It hadn’t happened at the frequency one would expect in games in which the Bills scored 37, 33, 36, and 23 points (against the No. 1 defense in football on the road). But in the second half against the Jets, the Bills demonstrated their ability to move the ball through the air in a normal, rhythmic way… at all levels of the field. And there was an explosive element that’s been mostly missing over the past four outings. For as good as Allen has been creating this season, and for as reliable as Buffalo has been on the ground, this team needs to be able to win with classic dropback passing too, and in the third and fourth quarters against the Jets, the Bills did just that. Here’s to hoping the likes of Christian Benford, Dorian Williams, and Dee Alford are OK. In their absence, Buffalo’s defensive depth was immediately tested. And it shined. sports.title: Josh Downs "excited to keep building" connection with Patrick Mahomes
sports.summary: Chiefs wide receiver Josh Downs didn't waste any time making an impact for his new team.
sports.body:
Downs joined the Chiefs in a trade with the Colts on Tuesday, which meant that he had limited practice time with quarterback Patrick Mahomes ahead of Sunday’s game in Atlanta. Their lack of familiarity with one another didn’t get in the way of Downs hauling in an 18-yard touchdown pass from the quarterback in the second quarter and he finished his Kansas City debut with four catches for 53 yards.

“Pat gave me a chance, and I went up and made a play ,” Downs said, via Nate Taylor of ESPN.com. “I’m excited to keep building off of that. First game and first touchdown, you can’t write it better than that. Playing with a guy like him is incredible. Doing anything you can to get open for him and making plays is what I want to do.”

Downs only played 10 offensive snaps in the 35-13 Chiefs win, which makes his production stand out all the more. It also leads to thoughts of what his connection with Mahomes will look like once they’ve had more time working with one another and those thoughts will be pleasant ones for Chiefs fans to ponder heading into Week 11.

sports.title: Mike Macdonald praises Tory Horton's "tremendous play" on late kickoff return
sports.summary: After the Raiders cut the Seahawks' lead to 21-13 by kicking a field goal with 2:04 left in Sunday's game, they wanted to force a touchback that would allow them to use the two-minute warning as a third timeout in hopes of getting the ball back.
sports.body:
Seahawks wide receiver Tory Horton made sure that didn’t happen. Horton perfectly timed a leap that allowed him to bat a kickoff that was sailing long into the end zone. Horton stepped out of bounds upon coming down, so he motioned for Rashid Shaheed to return it into the field of play and Shaheed was tackled with 1:59 left to accomplish the Seahawks’ goal of burning the Raiders’ extra chance to stop the clock.

Horton was flagged for an illegal bat of the ball, but the Raiders declined the penalty as it would have forced a re-kick that took more time off the clock and head coach Mike Macdonald praised Horton’s quick thinking in his postgame press conference.

“It was a tremendous play ,” Macdonald said, via the team’s website. “Tory’s actually trying to catch that ball, albeit with one hand. Just an incredible play. With George Holani going down, we had to take [Jadarian Price] off of kickoff returns, so those are guys that haven’t necessarily practiced a bunch in a while, especially with this game plan. So to be able to step in and be able to execute some of those critical situations is some great stuff by them, great job by our coaches, and it really helped us close the game out. . . . We told them that was the situation going. Now, there’s a difference between catching it 8 yards deep in the end zone and making a play like that, which is just some really, really great stuff.”

The Seahawks were likely to win the game regardless of how the kickoff played out, but Horton made closing things out easier and his effort will be on the minds of many people around the league if they find themselves in a similar situation.

sports.title: Dak Prescott: 49ers fans "were more present than ours"
sports.summary: On Sunday, America's Team wasn't even Dallas's Team. 49ers fans showed up in big numbers for the game against the Cowboys at AT&T Stadium.
sports.body:
After the game, Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott was asked whether the home team had to use the silent count.

“No, we didn’t go on the silent count,” Prescott said. "[We] anticipated it. I think y’all even potentially asked me on Thursday about it, having this many 49er fans there. Tricked myself and told myself early on that the red was for my high school.

“And at the end of the day, all I asked for is a great environment to play this game. And unfortunately, their fans were more present than ours, but it created a great atmosphere. So, we take the good out of it one way or another.”

For owner Jerry Jones, the colors worn by the fans don’t matter; their money is the same shade of green.

sports.title: Christian McCaffrey on career-high receiving yards: You just catch it and run as fast as you can
sports.summary: Christian McCaffrey had a day.
sports.body:
The 49ers running back had never had more than 121 receiving yards in a single game. He had 161 receiving yards on four catches Sunday against the Cowboys, scoring on catch-and-runs of 74 and 66 in the 49ers’ 46-40 win.

“You never know,” McCaffrey said. “You go into each game. You don’t really predict anything. Again, you just have to have the right mindset on a play that’s going to break. You trust your instincts and play fast.”

His first receiving touchdown came when Brock Purdy rolled to his right to buy time and found McCaffrey running free on the scramble drill.

“It really is backyard football at that point,” McCaffrey said. “We all played it as kids at recess, and you draw up plays on your hand, and it never happens. You ever tell a 5-year-old to run a post route, and he just runs a corner and something else, but he’s open? That’s kind of what that was. Again, I think those little decisions that you make in games, from Brock to scramble, not to just surrender the play but to keep it alive. That’s a big deal. There’s no planning that goes into that. It’s just him doing a great job playing ball.”

What turned out to be the game-winning touchdown came with 3:23 remaining when Purdy found McCaffrey, who was matched up against Von Miller, over the middle.

“They brought pressure,” McCaffrey said. “They dropped a D-end on me, so that’s a perfect look for that play. Again, it was a great job by Brock getting the ball where it needed to be. It made it easy for me.

“You just catch it and run as fast as you can to try to score. Don’t overthink it. You hope that nobody catches you, and you hope that you’re really fast so your teammates don’t catch up to you to celebrate, because it makes you look slow. We’ll have to check the tape.”

McCaffrey had a 16-yard touchdown run and 62 yards rushing. He is the first player in the Super Bowl era with at least 150 receiving yards, two receiving touchdowns, 50-plus rushing yards and at least one rushing touchdown.

sports.body: The Buffalo Bills earned their first AFC East divisional win this season thanks to a persistent attack that gradually wore down an overmatched New York Jets team in all three phases of the game. The Bills were once again held in check until halftime, but the offense came out with an aggressive swagger after the break that broke most of the Jets’ prior momentum. You might say that head coach Joe Brady has put together a masterclass in his first season at the helm, lulling opponents into a false sense of hope through the first two quarters, only to pull the rug out from under them when it counts. Buffalo again started the game on offense, thanks to another lost coin toss. It didn’t work out as Brady probably planned for in New Jersey, though the choice wasn’t his to make this weekend. The Jets’ forced a punt that soon ushered in a mid-tempo battle in the trenches for the duration of the half. The Bills eventually found the end zone in the first quarter thanks to another goal-line carry by Allen. The Jets’ defense caused plenty of early confusion and frustration for Allen and the passing game, ultimately holding them to just 10 points at halftime. If you caught his quick interview after the half, it was clear Brady was annoyed at his mostly stagnant first-half offense. They responded to what must have been an epic challenge speech in the locker room, which led to three second-half touchdowns and a 31-12 blowout win. A defense that’s been ranked as low as last and currently resides in the middle of the pack held an under-the-radar and (yes) talented Jets offense out of the end zone. These are the sorts of building blocks that matter when it comes to postseason discussions. sports.body: Plenty of people hand out game balls after the game. That’s easy. Watch the game, see who does well, give them the game ball. We’re doing something a little different. We’re handing out a pre-game ball. Before we watch the game, let’s settle on a player or players we think might be a decisive advantage for the Jets in the upcoming game. Occasionally we might hand out a pre-blame ball. If we think the Jets are going to get slaughtered, we’ll try to identify a prime culprit. One caveat: the quarterback is off limits. Nothing personal against quarterbacks, but they are obviously the most important players on the field. We could give out a pre-game or pre-blame ball to the quarterback virtually every week, but that would be boring, so we’re not going to do it. We’ll try to identify somebody besides the quarterback for the glory or the ignominy. This approach comes with the obvious drawback that predictions are difficult, especially about the future. We’re destined to get many of these wrong. No matter. We’ll have some laughs along the way. Let’s get to it. Today, for the second straight game, we’re handing out a pre-blame ball. It’s difficult to see a plausible Jets path to victory against the 7-1 Buffalo Bills, so pre-blame ball it is. The pre-blame ball for the Jets game against the Bills goes to (drum roll please) - Minkah Fitzpatrick! The Bills have a balanced and formidable offense. Josh Allen is as good a passer as any quarterback in the NFL. He also is one of the best running quarterbacks in the NFL. James Cook is one of the best running backs in the NFL. Through the air or on the ground, it doesn’t matter, the Bills can crush it. They field the best offense in the NFL in terms of yards gained and points scored. The defensive guys who have major responsibilities against the running game and the passing game tend to be the safeties more than anyone else. Minkah Fitzpatrick has responsibilities in the box and on the deep end of the Jets defense. Lately he has seemed to be mailing it in, making “business decisions” to not hustle. sports.body: The Jets have watched their season fall apart over the last three weeks. The team now sits at 2-7 with a daunting game against Buffalo in front of it. At this point in a lost season, fans frequently are ready to see a younger quarterback go into the lineup and get some reps. Most Jets fans haven’t reached that point, though, at least according to our most recent SB Nation Reacts poll. We asked whether it was Cade Klubnik time. A majority of fans who voted said they didn’t think putting in the fourth round rookie was the right move. [Image: https://platform.ganggreennation.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/86/2026/11/Jets_2_111226.png?quality=90&strip=all] While this might sound somewhat surprising on the surface, I think fans are making one simple consideration. Geno Smith hasn’t played badly enough to deserve a benching. Frequently when a season falls apart, the quarterback has done enough to lose his job. That has not yet been the case in New York. In other news, Jets fan confidence stayed stable despite a blowout loss in Kansas City.
